claims.wording: The implemented v2 policy and new workflow enforce the tested binding, type and authority guards.
claims.sample_domain: 58 authored controls and software regression/negative tests; 411 tests plus 6 subtests overall, not 411 images
claims.independence: Development, authored fixtures; no independent semantic truth
claims.assumptions: Trusted implementation/configuration; supported schemas and declared TD3 subset
claims.known_counterexample: A correctly bound but semantically poisoned reference can still pass declared support checks
claims.forbidden_stronger_wording: Hashes or passing tests prove a reference true
claims.upgrade_evidence: Independent audit plus approved, separately established references on a prospective cohort

claims.wording: On the authored pointwise controls, tier 2 increases selective risk from 2/25 to 1/7 while lowering labeled coverage from 25/25 to 7/25.
claims.sample_domain: 25 pointwise truth-labeled cases within 58 symbolic controls, zero physical IDs
claims.assumptions: Two fixed policy tiers, not calibrated confidence; exact stated denominators
claims.known_counterexample: Another distribution could reverse the risk ordering
claims.forbidden_stronger_wording: Tier 2 is generally worse, or greater abstention necessarily lowers risk
claims.upgrade_evidence: Prespecified independent reference/fault population with cluster-aware uncertainty

claims.wording: Two agreeing sources with the same constructed wrong reference produce a false alarm at both tiers.
claims.sample_domain: One correlated-poisoning counterexample added after run 01
claims.independence: Authored development amendment, not a naturally observed frequency
claims.assumptions: Both sources can inherit a shared semantic error
claims.known_counterexample: Truly independent valid evidence may resolve a reference error
claims.forbidden_stronger_wording: The experiment estimates how often real-world corroboration fails
claims.upgrade_evidence: Natural reference-defect observations with independently checked provenance and denominator

claims.wording: B and the equally informed flat predicate have identical tested states for 58 controls, two tiers and three endpoints.
claims.sample_domain: 58 symbolic controls; shared validator/guards by design
claims.independence: Development parity, not independent implementations of truth
claims.assumptions: Identical information, context, guard boundary and declared tiers
claims.known_counterexample: This does not test every possible input or prove general graph/flat equivalence
claims.forbidden_stronger_wording: Graph universally improves detection or universally equals every flat method
claims.upgrade_evidence: Locked independent cohort and separately audited comparable implementations

claims.wording: The historical B reference gate makes zero field/relation decisions without approved external references; selective risk is NA.
claims.sample_domain: 46 cached comparisons, 42 primary on 3 physical IDs; one-author phase-2 truth
claims.assumptions: Empty approved-reference set and frozen historical labels
claims.known_counterexample: All seven labeled primary pointwise faults are abstained, despite zero alarms
claims.forbidden_stronger_wording: B has zero error or superior reliability on the actual-model pilot
claims.upgrade_evidence: Approved independent references and a prospective evaluation with useful coverage

claims.wording: Strict intake validates all three issued packages and R02's 86 completed phase-1 items, preserves raw bytes and rejects duplicate import.
claims.sample_domain: Three existing ZIPs; one existing human submission checked read-only
claims.independence: Actual artifact compatibility, not verified reviewer independence
claims.assumptions: Expected issuance hash/code held separately; own phase 1 sealed before phase 2
claims.known_counterexample: A person sharing someone else's ZIP is not authenticated by JSON provenance alone
claims.forbidden_stronger_wording: The validator proves who filled the form or that their answers are gold
claims.upgrade_evidence: Real completed independent rounds, recorded roles/exposure and audited provenance

claims.wording: The synthetic signed workflow exercises agreement, disagreement, uncertainty, approval and revocation while production remains unapproved.
claims.sample_domain: Two synthetic views and three synthetic cases; production candidates/approvals zero
claims.assumptions: Designated public keys, protected trust/checkpoint configuration; low-level research APIs are not an authorization boundary
claims.known_counterexample: A valid signature authenticates an assertion but cannot establish semantic truth or human independence
claims.forbidden_stronger_wording: Three actual cases were adjudicated or a real reference was approved
claims.upgrade_evidence: Owner-designated authority and signed decisions on genuinely collected independent evidence

claims.wording: The extended audit finds recorded historical exposure for at least 192 of 1,000 MIDV-2020 instances across all ten types.
claims.sample_domain: 22,861 existing JSON files and cached provider template metadata
claims.independence: Read-only development audit; all 1,000 template metadata records accessed
claims.assumptions: Recorded identity/hash linkage is accurate; known MIDV-2020 aliases only
claims.known_counterexample: Missing logs, other corpus versions, decoded-pixel aliases and pretraining may hide further exposure
claims.forbidden_stronger_wording: The remaining 808 are unseen or the ten templates are held out
claims.upgrade_evidence: Complete claim-relevant cross-corpus identity/pixel/near-duplicate and exposure audit

claims.wording: Metadata inventory yields 1,100 potential C2 source pairs on 400 instances, with zero currently eligible pairs.
claims.sample_domain: Cached body/MRZ fields; 300 ID-number, 400 DOB, 400 expiry pairs
claims.independence: Mechanical candidate inventory, no image-pair human validation
claims.assumptions: Lexical field proposals need semantic/type approval; before/after support remains unknown
claims.known_counterexample: Full-date and YYMMDD differ in precision; native ID-number need not mean passport number
claims.forbidden_stronger_wording: 1,100 verified surviving backups or 1,097 annotation errors were found
claims.upgrade_evidence: Approved same-field equality, provenance and all before/after support conditions on bound mutations

claims.wording: The deterministic sizing calculator evaluates 384 declared design-effect scenarios for precision and a paired normal contrast.
claims.sample_domain: Illustrative assumptions, no sampled data or achieved power
claims.assumptions: Equal clusters, nonnegative exchangeable ICC, nondifferential label missingness; marginal endpoint illustrations
claims.known_counterexample: Rare outcomes, few clusters, unequal sizes or informative missingness invalidate a simple effective-N interpretation
claims.forbidden_stronger_wording: A defensible final sample size, exact power or observed confidence interval is established
claims.upgrade_evidence: Owner-approved estimand/margins/budget and validated cluster-aware design justification

claims.wording: A/B improves natural fault detection, oracle reliability or reviewer cost over an equally informed strong baseline.
claims.sample_domain: No prospective cohort or measured human active-time comparison
claims.assumptions: Would require valid independent truth, fair comparison, useful coverage and adequate design
claims.known_counterexample: Historical A/flat parity, shared poisoned reference and B all-abstain risk NA
claims.allowed_section: Research question and blocked future evaluation only
claims.forbidden_stronger_wording: B improves reliability, A is superior, or annotation cost is reduced
claims.upgrade_evidence: Completed locked prospective experiment with approved references and prespecified analysis/cost measurements

claims.wording: The project is ready to submit a B Research paper to EASE 2027.
claims.sample_domain: Development implementation, feasibility and draft design/outline
claims.assumptions: Scope relevance is distinct from novelty, soundness, adequacy, presentation and acceptance
claims.known_counterexample: Passing tests and a matching conference topic do not fill evidence or manuscript gaps
claims.forbidden_stronger_wording: The scope is fully satisfied, Research acceptance is assured or Emerging excuses weak methods
claims.upgrade_evidence: Closed scientific gates, appropriate evidence for the chosen claim, complete reviewed manuscript and anonymous rights-cleared artifact
